info.title: FUTABUS HTTP API
info.description: Current public HTTP API. Booking and account pages use web routes and are not represented as REST endpoints. The SePay webhook is called by SePay, not by customers.

post.summary: Receive a SePay bank transfer event
post.description: SePay calls this endpoint. Authentication mode is selected by server configuration: HMAC-SHA256 or API key. A successful HTTP response acknowledges receipt; it does not guarantee a booking was issued. Duplicate and unmatched transactions are handled by payment processing. Do not send test payments to a production account.

parameters.name: X-SePay-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp in seconds, accepted within five minutes when HMAC mode is active.

parameters.name: X-SePay-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + '.' + raw request body, prefixed with sha256=, when HMAC mode is active.

post.summary: Look up a ticket by phone and code
post.description: Rate-limited public lookup. Phone and code are supplied in the request body to avoid placing them in URLs or logs. Responses must not be cached.

post.summary: Reserve seats and create a SePay payment intent
post.description: Requires an active, verified account. A QR is not proof of payment; only a verified SePay webhook can mark an intent paid.

SePayHmac.name: X-SePay-Signature
SePayHmac.description: Requires X-SePay-Timestamp too. The signature covers the raw body and timestamp; a static key entered in Swagger UI cannot generate it.

SePayApiKey.name: Authorization
SePayApiKey.description: Exact value: Apikey <configured webhook key>. Used only when API-key mode is configured.
